inputs.query:
SELECT
    n.id AS negotiation_id,
    n.rfq_id,
    n.quotation_id,
    n.supplier_id,
    n.status AS negotiation_status,

    s.supplier_code,
    s.supplier_name,
    s.contact_name,
    s.email,
    s.supplier_status,

    q.version AS quotation_version,
    q.unit_price,
    q.total_price,
    q.quantity,
    q.available_quantity,
    q.delivery_at,
    q.payment_terms,
    q.warranty_quality,
    q.additional_notes,
    q.status AS quotation_status,

    r.status AS rfq_status,
    r.quotation_deadline,
    r.required_delivery_date,
    r.evaluation_policy,
    r.expected_supplier_count,
    r.minimum_valid_quotation_count,

    r.created_at AS rfq_created_at,
    n.created_at AS negotiation_created_at

FROM public.negotiations n

JOIN public.suppliers s
    ON s.supplier_id = n.supplier_id

JOIN public.quotations q
    ON q.id = n.quotation_id

JOIN public.rfqs r
    ON r.id = n.rfq_id

WHERE n.status = 'OPEN'

ORDER BY n.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

replaceEmptyStringsWithNull.description: Replace empty string values with NULL

inputs.query:
WITH target_supplier AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.event_context.source.supplier_id}}', 'null'), '')::uuid,
        (
            SELECT i.supplier_id
            FROM incoming_supply i
            JOIN components c
              ON c.component_id = i.component_id
            WHERE c.component_code = '{{$json.event_context.context.component_code}}'
              AND i.supplier_id IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY i.updated_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
        )
    ) AS supplier_id
)
SELECT
    s.supplier_id,
    s.supplier_code,
    s.supplier_name,
    s.supplier_status,

    ssh.supplier_status_history_id,
    ssh.status_timestamp,
    ssh.operational_status,
    ssh.delivery_status,
    ssh.capacity_utilization,
    ssh.quality_status,
    ssh.inventory_status,
    ssh.last_update_at,
    ssh.missed_update_count,
    ssh.status_details

FROM target_supplier ts
JOIN suppliers s
    ON s.supplier_id = ts.supplier_id
LEFT JOIN supplier_status_history ssh
    ON ssh.supplier_id = s.supplier_id

ORDER BY ssh.status_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20;

idleTimeout.description: Delay closing idle connection in seconds

replaceEmptyStringsWithNull.description: Replace empty string values with NULL

inputs.query:
SELECT
    nm.id AS message_id,
    nm.negotiation_id,
    nm.sender_type,
    nm.message_type,
    nm.content,
    nm.authorized_by,
    nm.execution_id,
    nm.created_at,

    n.rfq_id,
    n.quotation_id,
    n.supplier_id,
    n.status AS negotiation_status

FROM public.negotiation_messages nm

JOIN public.negotiations n
    ON n.id = nm.negotiation_id

ORDER BY nm.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

idleTimeout.description: Delay closing idle connection in seconds

inputs.query:
SELECT
    sc.supplier_id,
    s.supplier_code,
    s.supplier_name,
    sc.component_id,
    sc.reference_unit_price,
    sc.currency,
    sc.lead_time_days,
    sc.minimum_order_quantity,
    sc.is_qualified,
    sc.is_preferred_supplier
FROM public.supplier_components sc
LEFT JOIN public.suppliers s
    ON s.supplier_id = sc.supplier_id
ORDER BY sc.supplier_id, sc.component_id;

inputs.userPrompt:
You are the PRISM Negotiation Intelligence Agent.

Analyze the complete PRISM negotiation dataset provided below.

The dataset contains:
- negotiation_context
- supplier_history
- supplier_pricing
- negotiation_events

Use ALL available records.

Do not invent missing information.

If negotiation_context or negotiation_events are empty, use the available supplier history and supplier pricing, but clearly state that transaction-specific negotiation information is unavailable.

Analyze:

- supplier reliability
- delivery performance
- operational risk
- quality
- inventory
- capacity utilization
- reference pricing
- lead time
- MOQ
- qualification
- preferred supplier status
- previous negotiation events when available

Determine the appropriate action:
ACCEPT, COUNTEROFFER, ESCALATE, or REJECT.

Do not treat a reference price as the current quotation price.

Do not create a numerical counteroffer unless sufficient transaction-specific pricing information exists.

Return ONLY valid JSON:

{
  "negotiation_assessment": {
    "overall_status": "ACCEPT | COUNTEROFFER | ESCALATE | REJECT",
    "risk_level": "LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH",
    "summary": ""
  },
  "supplier_analysis": {
    "strengths": [],
    "weaknesses": [],
    "leverage_points": []
  },
  "commercial_analysis": {
    "current_price": null,
    "reference_price": null,
    "recommended_price": null,
    "currency": null,
    "price_change_reason": ""
  },
  "term_analysis": {
    "current_lead_time": null,
    "recommended_lead_time": null,
    "current_moq": null,
    "recommended_moq": null,
    "payment_terms": null
  },
  "recommended_action": {
    "action": "ACCEPT | COUNTEROFFER | ESCALATE | REJECT",
    "counteroffer": "",
    "reasoning": ""
  },
  "evidence": [],
  "uncertainties": []
}

PRISM NEGOTIATION DATA:

{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}
